events.title: Scenario: AI compute clusters may concentrate peak load near data-center substations
events.summary: Concentrated AI compute may create localized transformer and substation pressure. Utilities and procurement teams should monitor lead times and contingency sourcing.

events.title: Scenario: Critical-minerals availability could constrain transformer manufacturing
events.summary: Critical-minerals constraints could slow transformer manufacturing and increase reliance on secondary equipment markets. Procurement strategies should account for material-linked lead-time risk.

events.title: Scenario: Growing HVDC converter demand linked to renewable interconnection
events.summary: HVDC converter demand may rise with long-distance renewables, creating OEM capacity pressures with knock-on schedule risk for interconnection.

events.title: Scenario: Substation automation and AI controls increase cyber risk surface
events.summary: Faster substation automation adoption may raise cybersecurity exposure. Investment in security and operational procedures will be critical to realize benefits safely.

events.title: Scenario: Tariff and sourcing policy changes may shift OEM supply strategies
events.summary: Policy-driven sourcing preferences may cause short-term supply frictions while incentivizing longer-term domestic capacity building; procurement strategies should reflect both horizons.

events.title: Scenario: Rapid battery storage deployment could change distribution-level operations
events.summary: Battery deployment at scale will interact with distribution protection and operations; coordination and standards will be required to avoid unintended stability consequences.

events.title: Scenario: Mining permitting timelines add uncertainty to critical-mineral supply
events.summary: Permitting uncertainty in mineral jurisdictions could propagate to equipment lead times and cost volatility; diversification and inventory strategies will be consequential.

events.title: Scenario: Off-grid microgrids for data centers change local utility dynamics
events.summary: Microgrid adoption by data centers may ease transmission demand but requires coordination with local utilities to manage protection and commercial terms.

events.title: Scenario: Transmission corridor siting delays may elongate renewable interconnection timelines
events.summary: Siting and permitting delays for transmission corridors could slow renewable integration and prompt alternative strategies such as storage or phased interconnection.

events.title: Scenario: Secondary market growth for refurbished transformers could trade lead time for quality risk
events.summary: A larger secondary market could shorten supply-side pain but requires robust QA and contractual protections to manage lifecycle risk.
